case_title: ACQUISTAPACE, JAMES JR. VS HIDER, JOHN J.

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $4,500.00 FILED BY ACQUISTAPACE, JAMES JR. AS TO DEFENDANT HIDER, JOHN J. ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR NOV-30-2005 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT HIDER, JOHN J.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS TO DEFENDANT HIDER, JOHN J. DEFT FAILED TO APPEAR. PLFT DID NOT PROVIDE ANY EVIDENCE THAT HE HAD A C15-FLOORING AND FLOOR COVERING CONTRACTOR'S LICENSE. UNDER CALIFORNIA BUSINESS & PROFESSIONS CODE SECTION 7031, NO CONTRACTOR MAY BRING AN ACTION TO RECOVER COMPENSATION FOR WORK PERFORMED WITHOUT ALLEDGING THAT HE OR SHE WAS AT ALL TIMES DULY LICENSED. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
